I’m Duane, Co-founder and Managing Director of legal talent consultancy Realm.

At Realm we have a deep-seated belief that people should be happy at work...Happy people drive successful businesses. We’re not just recruiters — we’re growth partners for law firms.

And we do things a bit differently.

Here’s how:

🔹 Incomparably Specialist
We know the legal communities we work in better than anyone.
The lawyers we introduce you to? They’re not just looking for a job.
They’re looking for the right long-term move — and they trust us to help them find it.

🔹 Accountable
We take ownership of the process and we do what we say we’ll do.
No chasing, no hand-holding needed.
Just straightforward, honest recruitment that keeps moving.

🔹 Growth & Career Partners
We don’t just send CVs.
We help you shape your attraction, recruitment, and retention strategies —
so you can build a firm that not only hires well but holds onto its best people.

Our fill rates are exceptional.

We find you lawyers who stick around —
reducing your time spent recruiting, boosting your profit per hire, and growing your bottom line.

We make recruitment insightful and seamless —
so you can focus on doing what you do best: running your firm.


If you want a better way to hire, drop me a message.
📧 duane@realmrecruit.com

With each of our consultants covering just one practice area in a focused region, we know pretty much every lawyer you might want to recruit and every law firm you might want to join.
